summary: Official Jinan/Zhangqiu sources evidence a local natural-resources and real-estate registration custodian, but no anonymous public parcel ID plus polygon response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Simplified-Chinese discovery queries are recorded in city-10034-zhangqiu.json with actual result URLs. The native-language search directly identified the Jinan Zhangqiu District Natural Resources Bureau procedure page and Zhangqiu registration hall listing.
requestOutcomes: Bounded TLS-verified GETs used browser-like headers and a cookie jar. Jinan service and natural-resources hosts returned HTTP 403 WAF responses; the Zhangqiu government host returned a TLS internal alert; the national webmap catalog returned HTTP 200 but no parcel endpoint in inspected HTML; Tianditu returned HTTP 418 CloudWAF interception. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS disablement was used.
